creator: "We were supposed to collect berries, but there were no berries anywhere. I think in the ocean I saw some boxes but those are impossible to get." (games.fun research/foundations/evidence/creator-looks-playtest-2026-10-14.json)
rootCause: components/pickup put its spots with pool.add(q.x, 0, q.z): y = 0, the old yard's floor, is sea level on island terrain; the spots stood in the sea or inside the ground. The "boxes" were the berries: the composed games' prop.berry slot holds the kit's stand-in (CC0, standin-bake), a box, not a berry model.
fix: worlds/placement.js: one placement API on every three.js world (groundAt, waterAt, isWalkable, reach, place, route, walk.audit) over the world's own colliders; every part that places things moved onto it; gate D measure 6 reach leg (builder/tools/lib/reach-check.mjs).

levels.how: copies of the creator's three composed levels (games/ in the stream worktree, kit re-vendored), 60 s rounds with 3 seats (?seed=7&bots=3): idle = the local player stands still, play = a scripted player walks to the nearest berry by window.__game.routeTo with real keys (W A S D, Space where the route says jump, E near a berry); tool: the stream's scratch probe.mjs

regressions.how: node builder/gates/regress.mjs --record on the GPU (gpu-run.sh), then --only the reach and play ones again on the final code
regressions.final: --only pickups-at-sea-level, pickups-walled-off, pickups-on-reachable-ground, objective-out-of-reach, critter-lob-plays, idle-round on 1ecd42c: GREEN 6/6 in 851 s

notes: The berry slot of the three composed games is the kit's stand-in box: a looks-layer gap (a real berry model is needed), not a placement one.

Before the fix the berry-isles base (Critter Lob on Tower Isles terrain without the pieces' packs) put 0 of 10 berries in play: the seats stood on islands with no way across; measure 6 named it ("pickup was asked for 10 and put 0 in play"). With the pieces (bridge) it places 10.

examples.how: each example created fresh (builder/lib/create.mjs --from) and a build verify (builder/tools/verify.mjs) under gpu-run.sh, on 1ecd42c; crater-isles again on f3c9bcb (bots wander only where they can walk from)
notes: crater-isles failed measure 6 play leg on 1ecd42c (dead air) and on main 297ebe2 as well; it passed on f3c9bcb
not run: the vista examples (isle-hop, lantern-cove) and the godot examples: their runtimes do not carry the placement API and no file they run changed
foundAndFixed: a flat game has no world module: placement.js is now vendored into every three.js game (coin-hop did not boot)
